contract_traces: Spawn completes all recoverable preparation before creating owner tasks; no later awaited/Result-returning preparation can strand an already spawned task.
Finish signals shutdown/closes alternative and all optional origin H3 endpoints before borrowing each stored handle; every owner attempt completes before returning aggregate error or observations.
Mutable borrowed JoinHandles remain in self across awaits, so interrupted finish drops self and aborts every owner. No field is moved out from the Drop type.

UpgradeTaskFailure owns original boxed primary and every collected secondary (including nested aggregates); Error::source exposes original primary. Single cause remains downcastable through source; secondary remains owned, not stringified.
Owner task timeout requests abort and observes bounded join; retains initial Elapsed plus any completed task/JoinError/second timeout cause. Only cancellation after this explicit abort is accepted.
Origin accept error and active child failure are captured, listener drops, and full stop cleanup runs before return; alternative accept closure/child failure closes endpoint then drains.

Stop collects all already-ready outcomes before abort, preserving unexpected ready cancellation. After own abort, bounded join accepts only is_cancelled, retains all other completed errors, then snapshots any ready outcomes at deadline.
JoinSet Drop requests abort for still-unfinished children; timeout is returned rather than claimed successful quiescence.
Existing typed control markers, actual duplex destruction observations, literal authenticated H2/H3 positive requests/counts and all control bodies remain unchanged.
layout_assessment: Concrete owner/error/deadline helpers stay with their domain; repeated child drain is one concrete function. Preparation, shutdown, observation, abort and failure return form separate paragraphs. No speculative framework, source API or fixture bytes introduced.
verification_basis: Source reads and raw Git identity/differential checks only.

limits: No Cargo, native test, formatter/compiler or runtime command executed here.
Drop requests cancellation and endpoint close; it does not asynchronously join tasks or guarantee packet delivery/socket release before return.
On cleanup timeout unfinished tasks may remain; timeout cause is retained and remaining ownership aborts on Drop. No unconditional teardown claim.
Quinn endpoint.close is a close request, not wait_idle proof; no wait_idle completion claimed.
Listener accept-error cleanup and timeout/dropped-finish branches are source-reviewed but not separately executed by the retained fourteen baseline controls.
